name: Musou Guanzorumu
about: The Musou version of Guanzorumu, hunted in Musou quests. The server has no monster id of its own for it (quests list it as the normal Guanzorumu, with the normal monster's id), and the field guide's tables (the Ferias project) have no entry for it, so there are no HP, hitzone, stagger or carve tables here yet. 3 Musou quests list it.
